title: Sri Ramadasu
desc: Gopanna, a devotee of Lord Rama, goes through various trials and tribulations while collecting funds to construct a temple. He receives help from his deity throughout his journey.

title: Mad 2
desc: Laddu narrates his Goa adventure to jail visitors, where a stolen necklace, gangster Maxx and undercover cop Ashok lead to chaos, arrests and Laddu's jail time.

title: M.S. Dhoni: The Untold Story
desc: M S Dhoni, a boy from Ranchi, aspires to play cricket for India. Though he initially tries to please his father by working for the Indian Railways, he ultimately decides to chase his dreams.

title: Balagam
desc: A young man in severe debt believes that the only way to pay it off is through the dowry from his impending marriage. However, the death of his grandfather puts his plan on hold.

title: SALAAR PART 1
desc: The future of a fiercely disputed nation hinges on the strained dynamics between Deva and Vardha Raja, two allies-turned-enemies.

title: Mangalavaaram
desc: Maaya becomes the new sub-inspector of a village gripped by mysterious murders. But as she begins to investigate, she uncovers a web of dark truths and conspiracies.

title: Cinema Chupista Maava
desc: Irresponsible Kaththi falls head over heels in love with Parineeta. However, Parineeta's father sets certain preconditions that Kaththi needs to fulfil, in order to wed her.

title: Parking
desc: A parking spot frays the relationship between two neighbours of different generations and world views. Soon, the two men find themselves in an escalating battle to have the space all to themselves.

title: Kevvu Keka
desc: Lakshmi's father does not approve of her relationship with her boyfriend, Buchi, as he is not rich. She then challenges him that Buchi will become a millionaire in six months.

title: Bheema
desc: Sekar admires Chinna and teams up with him to take over the streets of Chennai. However, things change drastically when Sekar falls in love and decides to change his ways.

title: Adhurs
desc: Twin brothers, separated at birth, grow up in vastly different environments. However, they are reunited when one gets kidnapped by gangsters.

title: Lucky Bhaskar
desc: A struggling bank teller takes a chance on a shady investment scheme with an unproven partner. Later, as his fortunes rise, so does his ego, driving him to take on increasingly reckless risks.

title: Vikram
desc: A special agent investigates a murder committed by a masked group of serial killers. However, a tangled maze of clues soon leads him to the drug kingpin of Chennai.
